headline: Humyn Labs raises $47M Series A led by Accel
quote: The funding comprises $26 million in equity led by Accel
claim: India's Humyn Labs raised $47 million in Series A financing: $26 million equity led by Accel plus $21 million venture debt led by Lighthouse Canton.
why_it_matters: Indian teams are being funded to supply robotics training data to US labs, a niche a student builder could target.
title: India’s Humyn Labs raises $47M to feed US robotics companies the data they need | TechCrunch

headline: Dreamteam raises $53M from Together Fund, Accel, Premji Invest
quote: Dreamteam raised $53 million from Together Fund, Accel and Premji Invest.
claim: Dreamteam, an AI-first CRM founded in 2025 by former Freshworks leaders, raised $53 million from Together Fund, Accel and Premji Invest.
why_it_matters: Shows investors backing agent-based enterprise software built by Indian founders within a year of founding.
title: Daily Indian Funding Roundup & Key News - 17 November 2026: Dreamteam Raises $53 Million, Urban Company Opens ₹2,500 Crore QIP

headline: August AI raises $12M from Accel and Peak XV
quote: August AI has raised $12 million from Accel and Peak XV Partners
claim: August AI raised $12 million from Accel and Peak XV Partners and launched an AI agent that phones doctors, pharmacies and insurers for US patients.
why_it_matters: An IIT-BHU founder funded by top Indian VCs for a voice-agent product, a buildable pattern.
title: IIT-BHU alumnus Anuruddh Mishra's August AI raises $12 million to take on US healthcare paperwork

headline: Disseqt AI raises $8M led by Gresham House Ventures
quote: Disseqt AI raised $8 Mn in a funding round led by Gresham House Ventures
claim: Disseqt AI, which builds AI agents for AI governance and testing, raised $8 Mn (about ₹75 Cr) led by Gresham House Ventures; cricketer Rahul Dravid participated as an angel.
why_it_matters: AI governance and testing is drawing money; a niche with demand for engineers.
title: Disseqt AI Raises $8 Mn To Scale International Operations

headline: OpenAI brings free ChatGPT Plus for researchers to India
quote: New grants provide three ChatGPT Plus seats in a research workspace, free for 12 months, covering the recipient and up to two collaborators.
claim: OpenAI's researcher programme extends to India; applications open Monday, November 30, with 50,000 new grants globally, each giving three ChatGPT Plus seats free for 12 months.
why_it_matters: Only faculty and postdocs with a recent arXiv/bioRxiv/ChemRxiv paper qualify, so students should ask their guide.
title: OpenAI Offers Free ChatGPT Plus Access to Indian Researchers Under Global Initiative
